scientific_integrity: Finite verification is corroborative; the universal proof is supplied in RESULT.md. Theorem applies only to nonzero terminal-zero binary patterns and zero-origin progressions. No independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: All-zero patterns, arbitrary starts, other dilation factors, and quantitative bounds uniform in the pattern length are not covered. Potential unindexed priority overlap remains.
title: A finite-window automaticity theorem for doubled binary pattern progressions
